intro.data: A do-nothing step can sit in front of any machine. Pass the start through Pass Through, then through the Parser — you should still reach the goal, unchanged.
intro.alchemy: A do-nothing step can sit in front of any apparatus. Pass the start through Preserve, then through the Smelter — you should still reach the goal, unchanged.
intro.spellcraft: A do-nothing step can sit in front of any rune. Pass the start through Echo, then through Ignition — you should still reach the goal, unchanged.
intro.abstract: A do-nothing step can sit in front of any process. Apply id_A, then f — you should still reach the goal, unchanged.

goal.data: Wire the start through Pass Through and then the Parser to reach the goal.
goal.alchemy: Wire the start through Preserve and then the Smelter to reach the goal.
goal.spellcraft: Wire the start through Echo and then Ignition to reach the goal.
goal.abstract: Wire the start through id_A and then f to reach the goal.

afterSuccess.data: The Pass Through step did nothing, and you still reached the goal. Composing a machine with a do-nothing step gives back the same machine.
afterSuccess.alchemy: The Preserve step did nothing, and you still reached the goal. Composing an apparatus with a do-nothing step gives back the same apparatus.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: The Echo step did nothing, and you still reached the goal. Composing a rune with a do-nothing step gives back the same rune.
afterSuccess.abstract: The identity step did nothing, and you still reached the goal. Composing a morphism with identity gives back the same morphism.

reveal.summary: This is the identity law: putting an identity step before a process leaves it unchanged. f ∘ id_A is just f.
reveal.moreFormal: For every object A there is an identity morphism id_A. It is neutral for composition: for any f : A → B, f ∘ id_A = f. (And on the other side, id_B ∘ f = f.)
